# Cell Biology

Cells are the basic building blocks of all living things. The cell theory states
that all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

## Cell Structure

Every cell has a membrane, cytoplasm, and genetic material.

- Nucleus: holds the DNA
- Mitochondria: produces energy
- Ribosomes: build proteins

| Organelle | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Nucleus | Stores DNA |
| Mitochondria | Produces ATP |

### Example

```python
def is_alive(cell):
    return cell.has_membrane and cell.has_dna
```

## Cell Division

Mitosis produces two identical daughter cells from one parent cell.
